description: A React component example demonstrating how to configure Azure Text Moderation settings, manage state, handle user interactions, and display configuration details.

methods.name: handleCategorySelect
methods.description: Handles selection and deselection of categories, updating the component state.

methods.name: handleGlobalSeverityChange
methods.description: Updates the global severity threshold state.

methods.name: handleCategorySeverityChange
methods.description: Updates severity thresholds for specific categories.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Constructs the configuration object, logs it, and shows a success notification.

methods.name: handleReset
methods.description: Resets component state to default configuration and shows an info notification.
